records.context: The first Lab-native event-sourced ontology vertical in CyberAlchemy-lab.
records.intended_use: Candidate Product Capability meaning before DomainSpec v2 authoring.
records.challenge_or_refresh_route: CyberAlchemy v2 product owner plus CyberAlchemy Lab Ontology Lifecycle Project owner

propose.normative_voice: A Product Capability that calculates one governed ontology state at an exact graph commit cursor from canonical semantic event streams and exact governance event references.
propose.formal_voice: ReconstructGovernedOntologyState(E,G,c) returns OntologyAtCursor(c) or ReplayFailure; it does not read a projection as canonical input.
propose.plain_language_voice: Rebuild the ontology for one exact point from its events and checked governance links.
propose.domain_context_voice: The capability owns reconstruction behavior, not the meaning or authority of the ontology records it reconstructs.
propose.boundary: Do not treat a snapshot, generated graph, view, index, validator result, or successful replay as canonical semantic authority.
propose.drift_route: Refresh this candidate when CAL-ESOV-0003, its target Goal, or the selected canonicality model changes.

records.context: Per-node or per-relation semantic event streams in the first Lab-native ontology.
records.intended_use: Candidate identity boundary for event streams and reconstructed state.
records.decision_owner_route: CyberAlchemy Lab Ontology Lifecycle business-ontology owner
records.challenge_or_refresh_route: CyberAlchemy Lab Ontology Lifecycle business-ontology owner

propose.normative_voice: One identity-bearing ontology node or ontology relation whose semantic history is recorded in exactly one canonical subject event stream.
propose.formal_voice: OntologySubject = NodeSubject | RelationSubject, identified by (subject_kind, subject_id).
propose.plain_language_voice: The node or relation whose history the stream records.
propose.domain_context_voice: Node and relation subjects share the event mechanism but retain distinct semantic kinds.
propose.boundary: Do not use a file path, snapshot, display label, or generated index as the subject identity.
propose.drift_route: Refresh if stream granularity or subject-kind identity changes.

records.context: Canonical semantic history for one OntologySubject.
records.intended_use: Candidate canonical event meaning for later schemas and DomainSpec source.
records.decision_owner_route: CyberAlchemy Lab Ontology Lifecycle business-ontology owner
records.challenge_or_refresh_route: CyberAlchemy Lab Ontology Lifecycle business-ontology owner

propose.normative_voice: An immutable typed record for one OntologySubject that has one event identity, one graph commit cursor, and the complete resulting subject state.
propose.formal_voice: SemanticEvent = (event_id, subject_kind, subject_id, event_type, cursor, resulting_state).
propose.plain_language_voice: One permanent fact that says what one node or relation became at one ordered point.
propose.domain_context_voice: Semantic events calculate ontology meaning state; governance decisions remain in separate GovernanceEvent streams.
propose.boundary: Do not use a delta-only payload, mutable event, governance decision, projection, or snapshot as a SemanticEvent.
propose.drift_route: Refresh if event payload, canonicality, or semantic/governance topology changes.

records.context: Canonical event storage for one OntologySubject.
records.intended_use: Candidate stream boundary for later JSON storage and replay contracts.
records.decision_owner_route: CyberAlchemy Lab Ontology Lifecycle business-ontology owner
records.challenge_or_refresh_route: CyberAlchemy Lab Ontology Lifecycle business-ontology owner

propose.normative_voice: The append-only ordered sequence of canonical SemanticEvents for exactly one OntologySubject.
propose.formal_voice: SubjectEventStream(s) = [e | e.subject = s], ordered by strictly increasing GraphCommitCursor.
propose.plain_language_voice: The permanent history for one node or relation.
propose.domain_context_voice: Physical JSON files carry the stream but do not replace its semantic identity.
propose.boundary: Do not mix subjects, reorder committed events, overwrite prior events, or infer cursor contiguity that has not been selected.
propose.drift_route: Refresh if storage layout, append policy, or stream granularity changes.

records.intended_use: Candidate state payload meaning for deterministic subject reduction.
records.decision_owner_route: CyberAlchemy Lab Ontology Lifecycle business-ontology owner
records.challenge_or_refresh_route: CyberAlchemy Lab Ontology Lifecycle business-ontology owner

propose.normative_voice: The complete semantic state of one OntologySubject immediately after its SemanticEvent, including the subject identity and lifecycle marker required to interpret that state.
propose.formal_voice: reduce(previous_state,e) = e.resulting_state when e is valid for the same subject and later cursor.
propose.plain_language_voice: The full state the subject has after this event, not only what changed.
propose.domain_context_voice: Complete-state payloads make per-subject replay simple while the event remains the canonical record.
propose.boundary: Do not omit state needed to reconstruct the subject or treat the payload as a separately editable snapshot.
propose.drift_route: Refresh if payload completeness or lifecycle representation changes.

records.intended_use: Candidate consistent-cut coordinate before runtime schema design.
records.decision_owner_route: CyberAlchemy Lab Ontology Lifecycle business-ontology owner
records.challenge_or_refresh_route: CyberAlchemy Lab Ontology Lifecycle business-ontology owner

propose.normative_voice: A globally comparable monotonic position that places one SemanticEvent in the total order used to calculate ontology state.
propose.formal_voice: For accepted semantic events e1 and e2, cursor(e1) != cursor(e2) and cursor defines a strict total order.
propose.plain_language_voice: The shared ordering number that tells the whole ontology which semantic event came first.
propose.domain_context_voice: The cursor coordinates a consistent graph cut across separate subject streams.
propose.boundary: Do not equate the cursor with wall-clock time, file order, governance-event order, or an unselected contiguous-allocation policy.
propose.drift_route: Refresh if ordering, uniqueness, allocation, or cut semantics changes.

records.context: Graph assembly at one exact GraphCommitCursor.
records.decision_owner_route: CyberAlchemy Lab Ontology Lifecycle business-ontology owner
records.challenge_or_refresh_route: CyberAlchemy Lab Ontology Lifecycle business-ontology owner

propose.normative_voice: The calculated set containing the latest valid state at or before one GraphCommitCursor for every included OntologySubject, with every included relation endpoint resolvable in that same set.
propose.formal_voice: cut(c) = {latest(valid events(s) where cursor <= c) for each included s} subject to relation_endpoint_integrity.
propose.plain_language_voice: One whole-ontology view where every node and relation comes from the same ordered point.
propose.domain_context_voice: A cut is calculated state and carries no independent semantic authority.
propose.boundary: Do not combine subject states from incompatible cursors or retain a relation whose endpoint is absent at the same cut.
propose.drift_route: Refresh if cut membership or relation endpoint rules change.

records.context: Read-only reconstruction of the first Lab-native ontology.
records.intended_use: Candidate business query result before DomainSpec Query authoring.
records.decision_owner_route: CyberAlchemy Lab Ontology Lifecycle business-ontology owner
records.challenge_or_refresh_route: CyberAlchemy Lab Ontology Lifecycle business-ontology owner

propose.normative_voice: The read-only result of calculating a ConsistentOntologyCut for one exact GraphCommitCursor, or one typed ReplayFailure when no valid cut can be produced.
propose.plain_language_voice: Ask for the ontology at one exact cursor and get the consistent state or a clear failure.
propose.domain_context_voice: The result is suitable for machine and human projections but is not a new source of truth.
propose.boundary: Do not mutate events, fill missing meaning, omit failed subjects, or return a partial cut as success.
propose.drift_route: Refresh if query, cut, or failure semantics changes.

records.context: Machine state, human views, indexes, and validation summaries derived from canonical events.
records.intended_use: Candidate non-authority boundary for checked-in read models.
records.decision_owner_route: CyberAlchemy Lab Ontology Lifecycle business-ontology owner
records.challenge_or_refresh_route: CyberAlchemy Lab Ontology Lifecycle business-ontology owner

propose.normative_voice: A deterministic rebuildable representation derived from canonical SemanticEvents for one stated cursor and purpose.
propose.formal_voice: projection = project(OntologyAtCursor(c), projection_kind); deleting projection does not delete semantic history.
propose.plain_language_voice: A useful generated view that can always be rebuilt from the events.
propose.domain_context_voice: Machine state, human views, indexes, and validation summaries are projection kinds.
propose.boundary: Do not edit a projection to change ontology meaning or use it to repair missing canonical events.
propose.drift_route: Refresh if canonicality or checked-in projection policy changes.

records.context: Optional replay acceleration for one OntologySubject.
records.intended_use: Candidate snapshot boundary preserving event canonicality.
records.decision_owner_route: CyberAlchemy Lab Ontology Lifecycle business-ontology owner
records.challenge_or_refresh_route: CyberAlchemy Lab Ontology Lifecycle business-ontology owner

propose.normative_voice: A calculated replay accelerator that records one subject state and its exact source cursor and that must be replaceable by replaying canonical events.
propose.formal_voice: snapshot(s,c) = latest state of s at c; valid(snapshot) only if replay(events(s),c) equals snapshot.state.
propose.plain_language_voice: A cached latest state that makes replay faster but can be thrown away and rebuilt.
propose.domain_context_voice: A snapshot is never the latest truth by itself; its source cursor and replay equality are required.
propose.boundary: Do not accept a snapshot without its event history, exact cursor, or deterministic rebuild check.
propose.drift_route: Refresh if snapshot policy, projection policy, or replay equality changes.

records.context: Separate governance history related to semantic ontology events.
records.intended_use: Candidate governance-stream meaning before any enforcement model.

propose.normative_voice: An immutable typed record of one governance decision or lifecycle observation kept in a governance-owned stream and linked to semantic history only through exact references.
propose.formal_voice: GovernanceEvent does not belong to SubjectEventStream and does not alter ResultingSubjectState by replay.
propose.plain_language_voice: A separate permanent record of a governance action about semantic history.
propose.domain_context_voice: Separate streams preserve distinct semantic and governance owners.
propose.boundary: Do not store semantic state changes in GovernanceEvent or infer semantic authority from its presence.
propose.drift_route: Refresh if governance topology, ownership, or join semantics changes.

records.context: Exact join between separate semantic and governance streams.
records.intended_use: Candidate typed join contract for later business and system modeling.
records.decision_owner_route: CyberAlchemy Lab governance-event owner plus Ontology Lifecycle business-ontology owner
records.challenge_or_refresh_route: CyberAlchemy Lab governance-event owner plus Ontology Lifecycle business-ontology owner

propose.normative_voice: The exact tuple of semantic event identity, semantic event digest, and graph commit cursor used by a GovernanceEvent to identify one semantic event.
propose.formal_voice: GovernanceEventReference = (semantic_event_id, semantic_event_digest, graph_commit_cursor), and all three fields must match the same SemanticEvent.
propose.plain_language_voice: The three-part exact link from a governance record to one semantic event.
propose.domain_context_voice: The tuple prevents a governance record from joining to a convenient but different event version.
propose.boundary: Do not join by label, subject alone, file path, cursor alone, or digest alone.
propose.drift_route: Refresh if join fields or event identity rules change.

records.context: Business input to the future event append operation.
records.intended_use: Candidate input contract before DomainSpec Operation authoring.
records.decision_owner_route: CyberAlchemy Lab Ontology Lifecycle business-ontology owner
records.challenge_or_refresh_route: CyberAlchemy Lab Ontology Lifecycle business-ontology owner

propose.normative_voice: A request to validate and append exactly one proposed SemanticEvent to the canonical stream for its OntologySubject without changing prior events.
propose.formal_voice: append(request,e) succeeds only when e is schema-valid, identity-consistent, later in global order, and semantically valid for its subject kind.
propose.plain_language_voice: Ask to add one complete new event without rewriting history.
propose.domain_context_voice: The request proposes a write; successful validation does not itself grant semantic or governance authority.
propose.boundary: Do not batch implicit semantic changes, overwrite history, accept a projection as input, or infer owner approval from schema validity.
propose.drift_route: Refresh if append atomicity, validation, or authority boundaries change.

records.intended_use: Candidate failure outcome before runtime error schemas.
records.decision_owner_route: CyberAlchemy Lab Ontology Lifecycle business-ontology owner
records.challenge_or_refresh_route: CyberAlchemy Lab Ontology Lifecycle business-ontology owner plus CyberAlchemy Lab ontology runtime owner

propose.normative_voice: A typed non-success result produced when canonical event input cannot determine one valid ConsistentOntologyCut without guessing, omission, or authority escalation.
propose.formal_voice: ReplayFailure(reason, subject_ref?, event_ref?, cursor?) terminates OntologyAtCursor without a successful partial cut.
propose.plain_language_voice: A clear stop result when the events cannot safely produce the requested ontology.
propose.domain_context_voice: Examples include duplicate cursor, decreasing order, invalid subject transition, unresolved relation endpoint, and mismatched governance reference.
propose.boundary: Do not silently skip invalid events, repair history from projections, or return partial state as success.
propose.drift_route: Refresh when failure taxonomy or fail-closed behavior changes.

records.intended_use: Candidate business invariant before DomainSpec Rule authoring.
records.decision_owner_route: CyberAlchemy Lab Ontology Lifecycle business-ontology owner
records.challenge_or_refresh_route: CyberAlchemy Lab Ontology Lifecycle business-ontology owner

propose.normative_voice: A ConsistentOntologyCut satisfies RelationEndpointIntegrity when every included relation identifies source and target node subjects that exist in that same cut.
propose.formal_voice: forall r in cut.relations, exists source,target in cut.nodes where source.id = r.source_id and target.id = r.target_id.
propose.plain_language_voice: Every relation in the ontology points to nodes that exist in the same version of the ontology.
propose.domain_context_voice: The invariant is evaluated on calculated state and does not approve the meaning of the relation.
propose.boundary: Do not resolve endpoints from a later cursor, a stale snapshot, a display index, or an unadmitted external graph.
propose.drift_route: Refresh if endpoint existence, external references, or cut membership changes.
